log.body:

Moss Lane
COMMUNITY GARDEN
Neighbors growing together.

GROW WITH YOUR NEIGHBORS

A little time.
A lot of good.

A couple of hours, a few helping hands, and a garden we can all enjoy.

Find your volunteer shift at Moss Lane.
No gardening experience needed.

1
Choose your shift

A small commitment. A shared difference. All shifts are two hours.

Morning planting
Open

Saturday 24 October · 09:00–11:00

Help new things take root. Spend the morning planting in our garden beds.

4 available / 12 places
Path and bed care
Open

Saturday 24 October · 13:00–15:00

Give our shared spaces a little care, from garden paths to growing beds.

6 available / 10 places
Compost crew
Full

Sunday 25 October · 10:00–12:00

Turn garden scraps into good soil with the compost crew.

0 available / 8 places

Open places are shown as outlined squares.

2
Make it your shift

Just a name, and you’re ready to lend a hand.

Contact name (required)
YOUR CHOSEN SHIFT

Choose an open shift to see the details here.

Confirm my shift
↗

This is a local prototype. Your details stay on this page and no place is reserved.

New to the garden?

You’re in good company. Every helping hand makes a difference.

Small acts. Strong roots.

A garden grows better together.

Moss Lane Community Garden
Made for neighbors, by neighbors.
